versos.grego: Πρωΐας δὲ γενομένης συμβούλιον ἔλαβον πάντες οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ λαοῦ κατὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ὥστε θανατῶσαι αὐτόν·

controles.web: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
controles.kjv: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
controles.livre: Vinda a manhã, todos os chefes dos sacerdotes e anciãos do povo juntamente se aconselharam contra Jesus, para o matarem.

versos.grego: καὶ δήσαντες αὐτὸν ἀπήγαγον καὶ παρέδωκαν Πειλάτῳ τῷ ἡγεμόνι.

controles.web: and they bound him, and led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.
controles.kjv: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
controles.livre: E o levaram amarrado, e o entregaram a Pilatos, o governador.

versos.grego: Τότε ἰδὼν Ἰούδας ὁ παραδοὺς αὐτὸν ὅτι κατεκρίθη, μεταμεληθεὶς ἔστρεψεν τὰ τριάκοντα ἀργύρια τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ πρεσβυτέροις

controles.web: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
controles.kjv: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
controles.livre: Então Judas, o que o havia traído, ao ver que Jesus já estava condenado, devolveu, sentindo remorso, as trinta moedas de prata aos chefes dos sacerdotes e aos anciãos;

versos.grego: λέγων Ἥμαρτον παραδοὺς αἷμα ἀθῷον. οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Τί πρὸς ἡμᾶς; σὺ ὄψῃ.

controles.web: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.”   But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”
controles.kjv: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.
controles.livre: e disse: Pequei, traindo sangue inocente. Porém eles disseram: Que nos interessa? Isso é problema teu!

versos.grego: καὶ ῥίψας τὰ ἀργύρια εἰς τὸν ναὸν ἀνεχώρησεν, καὶ ἀπελθὼν ἀπήγξατο.

controles.web: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary, and departed. He went away and hanged himself.
controles.kjv: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
controles.livre: Então ele lançou as moedas de prata no templo, saiu, e foi enforcar-se.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς λαβόντες τὰ ἀργύρια εἶπαν Οὐκ ἔξεστιν βαλεῖν αὐτὰ εἰς τὸν κορβανᾶν, ἐπεὶ τιμὴ αἵματός ἐστιν.

controles.web: The chief priests took the pieces of silver, and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”
controles.kjv: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
controles.livre: Os chefes dos sacerdotes tomaram as moedas de prata, e disseram: Não é lícito pô-las no tesouro das ofertas, pois isto é preço de sangue.

versos.grego: συμβούλιον δὲ λαβόντες ἠγόρασαν ἐξ αὐτῶν τὸν ἀγρὸν τοῦ κεραμέως εἰς ταφὴν τοῖς ξένοις.

controles.web: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them, to bury strangers in.
controles.kjv: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter’s field, to bury strangers in.
controles.livre: Então juntamente se aconselharam, e compraram com elas o campo do oleiro, para ser cemitério dos estrangeiros.

versos.grego: διὸ ἐκλήθη ὁ ἀγρὸς ἐκεῖνος Ἀγρὸς αἵματος ἕως τῆς σήμερον.

controles.web: Therefore that field was called “The Field of Blood” to this day.
controles.kjv: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
controles.livre: Por isso aquele campo tem sido chamado campo de sangue até hoje.

versos.grego: τότε ἐπληρώθη τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἱερεμίου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος Καὶ ἔλαβον τὰ τριάκοντα ἀργύρια, τὴν τιμὴν τοῦ τετιμημένου ὃν ἐτιμήσαντο ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ,

controles.web: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,  “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,
controles.kjv: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;
controles.livre: Assim se cumpriu o que foi dito pelo profeta Jeremias, que disse: Tomaram as trinta moedas de prata, preço avaliado pelos filhos de Israel, o qual eles avaliaram;

versos.grego: καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐτὰ εἰς τὸν ἀγρὸν τοῦ κεραμέως, καθὰ συνέταξέν μοι Κύριος.

controles.web: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”
controles.kjv: And gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord appointed me.
controles.livre: e as deram pelo campo do oleiro, conforme o que o Senhor me mandou.

versos.grego: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἐστάθη ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ ἡγεμόνος· καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτὸν ὁ ἡγεμὼν λέγων Σὺ εἶ ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων; ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἔφη Σὺ λέγεις.

controles.web: Now Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?”   Jesus said to him, “So you say.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
controles.livre: Jesus esteve diante do governador, e o governador lhe perguntou: És tu o Rei dos Judeus? E Jesus respondeu: Tu o dizes.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐν τῷ κατηγορεῖσθαι αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ πρεσβυτέρων οὐδὲν ἀπεκρίνατο.

controles.web: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
controles.kjv: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
controles.livre: E, sendo ele foi acusado pelos chefes dos sacerdotes e pelos anciãos, nada respondeu.

versos.grego: τότε λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Πειλᾶτος Οὐκ ἀκούεις πόσα σου καταμαρτυροῦσιν;

controles.web: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”
controles.kjv: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
controles.livre: Pilatos, então, lhe disse: Não ouves quantas coisas estão testemunhando contra ti?

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ πρὸς οὐδὲ ἓν ῥῆμα, ὥστε θαυμάζειν τὸν ἡγεμόνα λίαν.

controles.web: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.
controles.kjv: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
controles.livre: Mas Jesus não lhe respondeu uma só palavra, de maneira que o governador ficou muito maravilhado.

versos.grego: Κατὰ δὲ ἑορτὴν εἰώθει ὁ ἡγεμὼν ἀπολύειν ἕνα τῷ ὄχλῳ δέσμιον ὃν ἤθελον.

controles.web: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner, whom they desired.
controles.kjv: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
controles.livre: Na festa o governador costuma soltar um preso ao povo, qualquer um que quisessem.

versos.grego: εἶχον δὲ τότε δέσμιον ἐπίσημον λεγόμενον Βαραββᾶν.

controles.web: They had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
controles.kjv: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
controles.livre: E tinham então um preso bem conhecido, chamado Barrabás.

versos.grego: συνηγμένων οὖν αὐτῶν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Πειλᾶτος Τίνα θέλετε ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν, Βαραββᾶν ἢ Ἰησοῦν τὸν λεγόμενον Χριστόν;

controles.web: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus, who is called Christ?”
controles.kjv: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
controles.livre: Quando, pois, se ajuntaram, Pilatos lhes perguntou: Qual quereis que vos solte? Barrabás, ou Jesus, que é chamado Cristo?

versos.grego: ᾔδει γὰρ ὅτι διὰ φθόνον παρέδωκαν αὐτόν.

controles.web: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.
controles.kjv: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
controles.livre: Pois ele sabia que foi por inveja que o entregaram.

versos.grego: Καθημένου δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοῦ βήματος ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ λέγουσα Μηδὲν σοὶ καὶ τῷ δικαίῳ ἐκείνῳ· πολλὰ γὰρ ἔπαθον σήμερον κατ’ ὄναρ δι’ αὐτόν.

controles.web: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.”
controles.kjv: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
controles.livre: E, enquanto ele estava sentado no assento de juiz, sua mulher lhe enviou a seguinte mensagem: Nada faças com aquele justo, pois hoje sofri muito em sonhos por causa dele.

versos.grego: Οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἔπεισαν τοὺς ὄχλους ἵνα αἰτήσωνται τὸν Βαραββᾶν, τὸν δὲ Ἰησοῦν ἀπολέσωσιν.

controles.web: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
controles.kjv: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
controles.livre: Mas os chefes dos sacerdotes e os anciãos persuadiram as multidões a pedirem Barrabás, e a exigirem a morte de Jesus.

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἡγεμὼν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τίνα θέλετε ἀπὸ τῶν δύο ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Τὸν Βαραββᾶν.

controles.web: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?”   They said, “Barabbas!”
controles.kjv: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
controles.livre: O governador lhes perguntou: Qual destes dois quereis que vos solte? E responderam: Barrabás!

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Πειλᾶτος Τί οὖν ποιήσω Ἰησοῦν τὸν λεγόμενον Χριστόν; λέγουσιν πάντες Σταυρωθήτω.

controles.web: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus, who is called Christ?”   They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”
controles.kjv: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
controles.livre: Pilatos lhes disse: Que, pois, farei de Jesus, que é chamado Cristo? Todos disseram: Seja crucificado!

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἔφη Τί γὰρ κακὸν ἐποίησεν; οἱ δὲ περισσῶς ἔκραζον λέγοντες Σταυρωθήτω.

controles.web: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?”   But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”
controles.kjv: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
controles.livre: E o governador perguntou: Ora, que mal ele fez? Porém gritavam mais: Seja crucificado!

versos.grego: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Πειλᾶτος ὅτι οὐδὲν ὠφελεῖ ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον θόρυβος γίνεται, λαβὼν ὕδωρ ἀπενίψατο τὰς χεῖρας κατέναντι τοῦ ὄχλου λέγων Ἀθῷός εἰμι ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τούτου· ὑμεῖς ὄψεσθε.

controles.web: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”
controles.kjv: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
controles.livre: Quando, pois, Pilatos viu que nada adiantava, em vez disso se fazia mais tumulto, ele pegou água, lavou as mãos diante da multidão, e disse: Estou inocente do sangue dele. A responsabilidade é vossa.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς πᾶς ὁ λαὸς εἶπεν Τὸ αἷμα αὐτοῦ ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ τέκνα ἡμῶν.

controles.web: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us, and on our children!”
controles.kjv: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
controles.livre: E todo o povo respondeu: O sangue dele venha sobre nós, e sobre os nossos filhos.

versos.grego: τότε ἀπέλυσεν αὐτοῖς τὸν Βαραββᾶν, τὸν δὲ Ἰησοῦν φραγελλώσας παρέδωκεν ἵνα σταυρωθῇ.

controles.web: Then he released to them Barabbas, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.
controles.kjv: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
controles.livre: Então soltou-lhes Barrabás, enquanto que mandou açoitar Jesus, e o entregou para ser crucificado.

versos.grego: Τότε οἱ στρατιῶται τοῦ ἡγεμόνος παραλαβόντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον συνήγαγον ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ὅλην τὴν σπεῖραν.

controles.web: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.
controles.kjv: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
controles.livre: Em seguida, os soldados do governador levaram Jesus consigo ao pretório, ajuntaram-se a ele toda a unidade miltar.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐκδύσαντες αὐτὸν χλαμύδα κοκκίνην περιέθηκαν αὐτῷ,

controles.web: They stripped him, and put a scarlet robe on him.
controles.kjv: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
controles.livre: Eles o despiram e o cobriram com um manto vermelho.

versos.grego: καὶ πλέξαντες στέφανον ἐξ ἀκανθῶν ἐπέθηκαν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ κάλαμον ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ, καὶ γονυπετήσαντες ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ ἐνέπαιξαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες Χαῖρε, Βασιλεῦ τῶν Ἰουδαίων,

controles.web: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him, and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
controles.kjv: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
controles.livre: E, depois de tecerem uma coroa de espinhos, puseram-na sobre a sua cabeça, e uma cana em sua mão direita. Em seguida, puseram-se de joelhos diante dele, zombando-o, e diziam: Felicitações, Rei dos Judeus!

versos.grego: καὶ ἐμπτύσαντες εἰς αὐτὸν ἔλαβον τὸν κάλαμον καὶ ἔτυπτον εἰς τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
controles.kjv: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
controles.livre: E cuspiram nele, tomaram a cana, e deram-lhe golpes na cabeça.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅτε ἐνέπαιξαν αὐτῷ, ἐξέδυσαν αὐτὸν τὴν χλαμύδα καὶ ἐνέδυσαν αὐτὸν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀπήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ σταυρῶσαι.

controles.web: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off of him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.
controles.kjv: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
controles.livre: Depois de terem o zombado, despiram-lhe a capa, vestiram-no com suas roupas, e o levaram para crucificar.

versos.grego: Ἐξερχόμενοι δὲ εὗρον ἄνθρωπον Κυρηναῖον, ὀνόματι Σίμωνα· τοῦτον ἠγγάρευσαν ἵνα ἄρῃ τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.
controles.kjv: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
controles.livre: Ao saírem, encontraram um homem de Cirene, por nome Simão; e obrigaram-no a levar sua cruz.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐλθόντες εἰς τόπον λεγόμενον Γολγοθᾶ, ὅ ἐστιν κρανίου τόπος λεγόμενος,

controles.web: They came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull.”
controles.kjv: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
controles.livre: E quando chegaram ao lugar chamado Gólgota, que significa “o lugar da caveira”,

versos.grego: ἔδωκαν αὐτῷ πιεῖν οἶνον μετὰ χολῆς μεμιγμένον· καὶ γευσάμενος οὐκ ἠθέλησεν πιεῖν.

controles.web: They gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.
controles.kjv: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
controles.livre: deram-lhe de beber vinho misturado com fel. E, depois de provar, não quis beber.

versos.grego: σταυρώσαντες δὲ αὐτὸν διεμερίσαντο τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ βάλλοντες κλῆρον,

controles.web: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,
controles.kjv: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
controles.livre: E havendo-o crucificado, repartiram suas roupas, lançando sortes.

versos.grego: καὶ καθήμενοι ἐτήρουν αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ.

controles.web: and they sat and watched him there.
controles.kjv: And sitting down they watched him there;
controles.livre: Então se sentaram, e ali o vigiavam.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπάνω τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ τὴν αἰτίαν αὐτοῦ γεγραμμένην ΟΥΤΟΣ ΕΣΤΙΝ ΙΗΣΟΥΣ Ο ΒΑΣΙΛΕΥΣ ΤΩΝ ΙΟΥΔΑΙΩΝ.

controles.web: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
controles.kjv: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
controles.livre: E puseram, por cima de sua cabeça, sua acusação escrita: ESTE É JESUS, O REI DOS JUDEUS.

versos.grego: Τότε σταυροῦνται σὺν αὐτῷ δύο λῃσταί, εἷς ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ εἷς ἐξ εὐωνύμων.

controles.web: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.
controles.kjv: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
controles.livre: Então foram crucificados com ele dois criminosos,  um à direita, e outro à esquerda.

versos.grego: Οἱ δὲ παραπορευόμενοι ἐβλασφήμουν αὐτὸν κινοῦντες τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν

controles.web: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads,
controles.kjv: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
controles.livre: Os que passavam blasfemavam dele, balançando suas cabeças,

versos.grego: καὶ λέγοντες Ὁ καταλύων τὸν ναὸν καὶ ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις οἰκοδομῶν, σῶσον σεαυτόν, εἰ Υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ κατάβηθι ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ.

controles.web: and saying, “You who destroy the temple, and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”
controles.kjv: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
controles.livre: e dizendo: Tu, que derrubas o Templo, e em três dias o reconstróis, salva a ti mesmo! Se és Filho de Deus, desce da cruz.

versos.grego: ὁμοίως οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ἐμπαίζοντες μετὰ τῶν γραμματέων καὶ πρεσβυτέρων ἔλεγον

controles.web: Likewise the chief priests also mocking, with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,
controles.kjv: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,
controles.livre: E da mesma maneira também os chefes dos sacerdotes, com os escribas e os anciãos, escarnecendo dele ,diziam:

versos.grego: Ἄλλους ἔσωσεν, ἑαυτὸν οὐ δύναται σῶσαι· Βασιλεὺς Ἰσραήλ ἐστιν, καταβάτω νῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ καὶ πιστεύσομεν ἐπ’ αὐτόν.

controles.web: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.
controles.kjv: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
controles.livre: Salvou outros, a si mesmo não pode salvar. Ele é Rei de Israel, desça agora da cruz, e creremos nele.

versos.grego: πέποιθεν ἐπὶ τὸν Θεόν, ῥυσάσθω νῦν εἰ θέλει αὐτόν· εἶπεν γὰρ ὅτι Θεοῦ εἰμι Υἱός.

controles.web: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”
controles.kjv: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
controles.livre: Confiou em Deus, livre-o agora, se lhe quer bem; pois disse: “Sou Filho de Deus”.

versos.grego: τὸ δ’ αὐτὸ καὶ οἱ λῃσταὶ οἱ συνσταυρωθέντες σὺν αὐτῷ ὠνείδιζον αὐτόν.

controles.web: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.
controles.kjv: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
controles.livre: E os ladrões que estavam crucificados com ele também lhe insultavam.

versos.grego: Ἀπὸ δὲ ἕκτης ὥρας σκότος ἐγένετο ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἕως ὥρας ἐνάτης.

controles.web: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
controles.kjv: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
controles.livre: Desde a hora sexta  houve trevas sobre toda a terra até a hora nona.

versos.grego: περὶ δὲ τὴν ἐνάτην ὥραν ἀνεβόησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγων Ἡλεὶ Ἡλεὶ λεμὰ σαβαχθανεί; τοῦτ’ ἔστιν Θεέ μου θεέ μου, ἵνα τί με ἐγκατέλιπες;

controles.web: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, limasabachthani?”  That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
controles.kjv: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
controles.livre: E perto da hora nona, Jesus gritou em alta voz: Eli, Eli, lemá sabactâni?, Isto é: Deus meu, Deus meu, porque me desamparaste?

versos.grego: τινὲς δὲ τῶν ἐκεῖ ἑστηκότων ἀκούσαντες ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἡλείαν φωνεῖ οὗτος.

controles.web: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”
controles.kjv: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
controles.livre: E alguns dos que ali estavam, quando ouviram, disseram: Ele está chamando Elias.

versos.grego: καὶ εὐθέως δραμὼν εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν καὶ λαβὼν σπόγγον πλήσας τε ὄξους καὶ περιθεὶς καλάμῳ ἐπότιζεν αὐτόν.

controles.web: Immediately one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.
controles.kjv: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
controles.livre: Logo um deles correu e tomou uma esponja. Então a encheu de vinagre, colocou-a em uma cana, e lhe dava de beber.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ λοιποὶ εἶπαν Ἄφες ἴδωμεν εἰ ἔρχεται Ἡλείας σώσων αὐτόν.

controles.web: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”
controles.kjv: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
controles.livre: Porém os outros disseram: Deixa, vejamos se Elias vem livrá-lo.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς πάλιν κράξας φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ἀφῆκεν τὸ πνεῦμα.

controles.web: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.
controles.kjv: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
controles.livre: Jesus gritou outra vez em alta voz, e entregou o espírito.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἰδοὺ τὸ καταπέτασμα τοῦ ναοῦ ἐσχίσθη ἀπ’ ἄνωθεν ἕως κάτω εἰς δύο, καὶ ἡ γῆ ἐσείσθη, καὶ αἱ πέτραι ἐσχίσθησαν,

controles.web: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
controles.kjv: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
controles.livre: E eis que o véu do Templo se rasgou em dois, de cima até embaixo, a terra tremeu, e as pedras se fenderam.

versos.grego: καὶ τὰ μνημεῖα ἀνεῴχθησαν καὶ πολλὰ σώματα τῶν κεκοιμημένων ἁγίων ἠγέρθησαν·

controles.web: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;
controles.kjv: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
controles.livre: Os sepulcros se abriram, e muitos corpos de santos que tinham morrido  foram ressuscitados.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξελθόντες ἐκ τῶν μνημείων μετὰ τὴν ἔγερσιν αὐτοῦ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὴν ἁγίαν πόλιν καὶ ἐνεφανίσθησαν πολλοῖς.

controles.web: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.
controles.kjv: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
controles.livre: E, depois de ressuscitarem, saíram dos sepulcros, vieram à santa cidade,  e apareceram a muitos.

versos.grego: Ὁ δὲ ἑκατόνταρχος καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ τηροῦντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἰδόντες τὸν σεισμὸν καὶ τὰ γινόμενα ἐφοβήθησαν σφόδρα, λέγοντες Ἀληθῶς Θεοῦ Υἱὸς ἦν οὗτος.

controles.web: Now the centurion, and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake, and the things that were done, feared exceedingly, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God.”
controles.kjv: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
controles.livre: E o centurião, e os que com ele vigiavam Jesus, ao verem o terremoto e as coisas que haviam sucedido, tiveram muito medo, e disseram: Verdadeiramente ele era Filho de Deus.

versos.grego: Ἦσαν δὲ ἐκεῖ γυναῖκες πολλαὶ ἀπὸ μακρόθεν θεωροῦσαι, αἵτινες ἠκολούθησαν τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας διακονοῦσαι αὐτῷ·

controles.web: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.
controles.kjv: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
controles.livre: Muitas mulheres, que desde a Galileia haviam seguido Jesus, e o serviam, estavam ali, olhando de longe.

versos.grego: ἐν αἷς ἦν Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνή, καὶ Μαρία ἡ τοῦ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωσὴφ μήτηρ, καὶ ἡ μήτηρ τῶν υἱῶν Ζεβεδαίου.

controles.web: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
controles.kjv: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee’s children.
controles.livre: Entre elas estavam Maria Madalena, e Maria mãe de Tiago e de José, e a mãe dos filhos de Zebedeu.

versos.grego: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης ἦλθεν ἄνθρωπος πλούσιος ἀπὸ Ἀριμαθαίας, τοὔνομα Ἰωσήφ, ὃς καὶ αὐτὸς ἐμαθητεύθη τῷ Ἰησοῦ·

controles.web: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea, named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple came.
controles.kjv: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus’ disciple:
controles.livre: E chegado o entardecer, veio um homem rico de Arimateia, por nome José, que também era discípulo de Jesus.

versos.grego: οὗτος προσελθὼν τῷ Πειλάτῳ ᾐτήσατο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ. τότε ὁ Πειλᾶτος ἐκέλευσεν ἀποδοθῆναι.

controles.web: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.
controles.kjv: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
controles.livre: Ele chegou a Pilatos, e pediu o corpo de Jesus. Então Pilatos mandou que lhe fosse entregue.

versos.grego: καὶ λαβὼν τὸ σῶμα ὁ Ἰωσὴφ ἐνετύλιξεν αὐτὸ ἐν σινδόνι καθαρᾷ,

controles.web: Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
controles.kjv: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
controles.livre: José tomou o corpo, e o envolveu em um lençol limpo, de linho fino,

versos.grego: καὶ ἔθηκεν αὐτὸ ἐν τῷ καινῷ αὐτοῦ μνημείῳ ὃ ἐλατόμησεν ἐν τῇ πέτρᾳ, καὶ προσκυλίσας λίθον μέγαν τῇ θύρᾳ τοῦ μνημείου ἀπῆλθεν.

controles.web: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock, and he rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, and departed.
controles.kjv: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
controles.livre: e o pôs em seu sepulcro novo, que tinha escavado numa rocha; em seguida rolou uma grande pedra à porta do sepulcro, e foi embora.

versos.grego: Ἦν δὲ ἐκεῖ Μαριὰμ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ ἡ ἄλλη Μαρία, καθήμεναι ἀπέναντι τοῦ τάφου.

controles.web: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.
controles.kjv: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
controles.livre: E ali estavam Maria Madalena e a outra Maria, sentadas de frente ao sepulcro.

versos.grego: Τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον, ἥτις ἐστὶν μετὰ τὴν Παρασκευήν, συνήχθησαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι πρὸς Πειλᾶτον

controles.web: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,
controles.kjv: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
controles.livre: No dia seguinte, que é o depois da preparação, os chefes dos sacerdotes, e os fariseus se reuniram com Pilatos,

versos.grego: λέγοντες Κύριε, ἐμνήσθημεν ὅτι ἐκεῖνος ὁ πλάνος εἶπεν ἔτι ζῶν Μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἐγείρομαι.

controles.web: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’
controles.kjv: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
controles.livre: e disseram: Senhor, nos lembramos que aquele enganador, enquanto ainda vivia, disse: “Depois de três dias serei ressuscitado”.

versos.grego: κέλευσον οὖν ἀσφαλισθῆναι τὸν τάφον ἕως τῆς τρίτης ἡμέρας, μή ποτε ἐλθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ κλέψωσιν αὐτὸν καὶ εἴπωσιν τῷ λαῷ Ἠγέρθη ἀπὸ τῶν νεκρῶν, καὶ ἔσται ἡ ἐσχάτη πλάνη χείρων τῆς πρώτης.

controles.web: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”
controles.kjv: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
controles.livre: Portanto, manda que o sepulcro esteja em segurança até o terceiro dia, para que não aconteça dos os discípulos virem, e o furtem, e digam ao povo que ele ressuscitou dos mortos; e assim o último engano será pior que o primeiro.

versos.grego: ἔφη αὐτοῖς ὁ Πειλᾶτος Ἔχετε κουστωδίαν· ὑπάγετε ἀσφαλίσασθε ὡς οἴδατε.

controles.web: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”
controles.kjv: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
controles.livre: Pilatos lhes disse: Vós tendes uma guarda. Ide fazer segurança como o entendeis.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ πορευθέντες ἠσφαλίσαντο τὸν τάφον σφραγίσαντες τὸν λίθον μετὰ τῆς κουστωδίας.

controles.web: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.
controles.kjv: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
controles.livre: E eles se foram, e fizeram segurança no sepulcro com a guarda, selando a pedra.
